learn.summary: A transformer moves AC energy between 2 coils through a shared magnetic core. The turns ratio sets the voltage ratio.
tips: Pins p1 and p2 are the primary (red winding). Pins s1 and s2 are the secondary (yellow winding).
It works only with changing current (AC). With DC, the secondary voltage falls to 0.
A step-down transformer gives a lower voltage and a higher current on the secondary.
